Incident technique sur le cœur de réseau: Technical incident on Orange's 5G core network
Une interruption majeure des services mo: A major mobile service outage affected a large number of Orange and Sosh brand customers between 11:20 AM and 8:30 PM. The incident resulted in the loss of 4G and 5G connectivity for millions of users nationwide, without however impacting all subscribers.
L'origine des perturbations réside dans: The origin of the disruptions lies in the failure of equipment related to the deployment of the company's new 5G core network. This hardware breakdown directly impaired customer session management. The telecom operator formally ruled out the possibility of a cyberattack or a malfunction related to PHP, while conceding that the precise cause of the failure remains misunderstood.
Pour rétablir le trafic, l'opérateur s'e: To restore traffic, the operator relied on the technical assistance of equipment manufacturer Nokia to develop a temporary workaround. Engineering teams proceeded with the gradual resynchronization of the affected subscribers' access, first individually and then in successive waves, allowing a return to normal formalized at 9:00 PM.
Cette panne constitue le troisième dysfo: This outage constitutes the third nationwide malfunction suffered by the operator this year, following two previous outages observed in January and June. Faced with the inconvenience caused, Orange's management announced a commercial gesture consisting of doubling the internet data volume included in the affected customers' plans for one month, starting from their plan renewal.
Une panne touchant le nouveau cœur de ré: An outage affecting Orange's new 5G core network interrupted 4G and 5G access for millions of Orange and Sosh subscribers.
